name: Microwave Water Heating Task State
description: State variables the intent monitor LLM must track from video frames

current_phase.description: Current high-level phase of the task

current_action.description: Specific action currently being performed (must match a DAG node id)

human_state.description: Current activity of the human operator

water_in_cup.description: Water has been poured into the black cup

microwave_on.description: Microwave is currently running (interior light on / turntable spinning / running sound)

cup_heated.description: The water in the black cup has finished heating (microwave completed a heating cycle with the cup inside)

predicted_next_action.description: Predicted next action based on task graph (shares valid_values with current_action)

prediction_confidence.description: Confidence in the predicted next action (0-1)

robot_state.description: Robot execution status (populated from robot API, not vision)

robot_active_program.description: Current robot program/action id when busy (populated from robot API, not vision)

robot_engagement.description: Vision-informed judgement from the intent monitor on whether the robot should continue its actions now. 'continue' = safe to proceed with scheduled actions; 'hold' = defer all non-safety robot activity. The BT gates deterministic action branches on this being 'continue'.

black_cup_location.description: Current location of the black cup (the cup that gets filled and microwaved).

white_cup_location.description: Current location of the white cup.
